info.title: Coinme Crypto-as-a-Service API
info.description: Coinme Crypto-as-a-Service (CaaS) API. Harvested from provider-published per-endpoint OpenAPI blocks at docs.coinme.com/reference. Modular crypto infrastructure: KYC onboarding, quotes, buy/sell orders, wallets, sends, cash on/off-ramp, payment methods, and webhooks.

post.description: The following API will attempt to retrieve the personal information for a user given their phone number and Social Security number. In order to keep the information confidential, Coinme uses a third party, VeryGoodSecurity, as a reverse proxy to create a token for the ssn upon the request and then decrypt the token on the request to Prove’s pre-fill service.

parameters.description: Partner User Agent ID (provided by Coinme)

message.example: Subscriber is not found on the required whitelist. -

post.description: This endpoint can be called to verify that the submitted data correctly matches the customer associated with it. The more data input, the more accurate of a result can be returned. In order to keep the information confidential, Coinme uses a third party, VeryGoodSecurity, as a reverse proxy to create a token for the ssn upon the request and then decrypt the token on the request to Prove’s pre-fill service.

post.description: Return crypto quote for amount exchanged from one currency to another and it’s expiration time in UTC. Response also includes a quoteId, which can be used to initiate a transaction. Quotes expire after 30 seconds by default.

parameters.name: User-Agent
parameters.description: Partner User Agent ID (provided by Coinme)

providerId.description: ID of payment provider (provided by Coinme)

amountValue.description: Amount to buy or sell. This is used as the input value to calculate the quote

amountCurrencyCode.description: Currency code of amount (i.e. USD). It must match either creditCurrency or debitCurrency

locationReference.description: should be specified only if fiat settlement is done through Coinme and requires a physical location (i.e. selling crypto for cash)

latitude.description: latitude of location when selling crypto for cash (i.e. -78.617716)

longitude.description: longitude of location when selling crypto for cash (i.e. 62.936942)

cryptoSettlementType.description: Possible values are "INTERNAL" or "EXTERNAL". defaults to "INTERNAL". Use "EXTERNAL" to also calculate blockchain fees

chain.description: Possible values are "XLM", "ETH", or "LINEA". Use only if Coinme supports trading this currency on multiple chains. otherwise unnecessary

promoCode.description: Applies promotional fees for this transaction. Please contact your Coinme Account Manager to set up a custom promotional code

parameters.name: User-Agent
parameters.description: Partner User Agent ID (provided by Coinme)

partnerTransactionId.description: Optional - automatically generated if not provided

paymentMethodId.description: Optional -  required if using Coinme digital payment processing

externalCustodyCreditInfo.description: Applicable for BUY flow only when sending to an external wallet (not custodied by Coinme), details for sending crypto to external wallet

walletAddress.description: Wallet address to send crypto to. Required for external crypto deposit

quoteInput.description: Details required to create a quote

locationReference.description: should be specified only if fiat settlement is done through Coinme and requires a physical location (i.e. selling crypto for cash)

latitude.description: latitude of location when selling crypto for cash (i.e. -78.617716)

longitude.description: longitude of location when selling crypto for cash (i.e. 62.936942)

cryptoSettlementType.description: Possible values are "INTERNAL" or "EXTERNAL". defaults to "INTERNAL". Use "EXTERNAL" to also calculate blockchain fees

chain.description: Possible values are "XLM", "ETH", or "LINEA". Use only if Coinme supports trading this currency on multiple chains. otherwise unnecessary

sourceWalletAddress.description: Applicable for SELL flow only when selling from an external wallet (not custodied by Coinme), indicates from what wallet address is crypto sent

tags.description: Optional - tags can be used to mark a transaction with unique keywords

webSessionId.description: Optional -  field is required only if partner is provisioned to have Coinme digital transaction processing screened by a security provider
